# Acme stubs

A studio's repo, after the product spec's Acme example, with stub sources so
it builds: a private map (`automap-private/`) layered over the fixture map,
with an in-repo library (`acme-tools`, whose source is `engine/acme-tools/`)
and a patched variant of `stub-ui` (`acme-patched`) built from an overlay port
in the private map. Everything here is MIT-0.
